FROM (
  with ae_temp as (
      select investment_dept, investment_strat, business_date,
             (case when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then 0
                   when (product_type = 'Equity Swap') then abacus_notional_base_ccy + abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then 0 
                   when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                   else abacus_pv_base_ccy end
             ) as exposure
      from "risk_prod"."rmv_position"
      where investment_dept = 'Active Equities' and portfolio_type = 'IP' and product_type in ('Common Stock','Common Stock Private','Convertible_bond','Equity Swap','Private Emerging Mkt Fund', 'Synthetic Equity Index','Unit','Pooled Fund Absolute Return','Listed Warrant','Preferred Stock','REIT','Depository Receipt','Leveraged Loans') and long_short = 'LONG'

  select q1.business_date, q1.node_name, q1.long_pv, analytics.analytic_name, analytics.analytic_value,

    ),

        where node in ('Active Equities','Asia','Europe','LatAm','North America','AE Enhanced Beta')
        and portfolio_type = 'IP' 
        and analytic_name in ('10 Year VaR', '10 Year Volatility','2 Year VaR', '2 Year Volatility','5 Year Expected Shortfall') 
        and (confidence_level is null or confidence_level = 0.95)
    )
    
    select q1.business_date, q1.node_name, q1.long_pv, analytics.analytic_name, analytics.analytic_value,
           (analytics.analytic_value / q1.long_pv) * 100 as "% analytics"
    from (
        select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_strat as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv
        from ae_temp
        group by ae_temp.investment_strat, ae_temp.business_date
    
        union
    
        select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_dept as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv

    ) as q1
    right join analytics

          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')

            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp

/* cppi::59acb4305fe9c3e635751f7945e4b27cdaea683fd21c40e8d4573fd24eb6d656 */
WITH prev_business_date AS
         (
             SELECT
                 max(fact.business_date) as business_date
             FROM radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date < '2025-05-23'
         ),
	current_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      parent.party_name,
	      parent.cppib_party_id,
	      parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      COALESCE( country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS country_code,
	      parent.rtg_final AS rtg_final,
	      parent.rtg_outlook AS rtg_outlook,

	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
		  MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	    FROM
	      radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
	      radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_prod.ref_country country ON country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = country.alpha_2_code
	    WHERE
	      fact.business_date = '2025-05-23'
		  and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	      AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	      AND
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
				    parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )

WITH RankedSecurities AS (

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-02'

SELECT
    ss.portfolio_id AS id_portfolio,
    NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
    ss.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
    udl.bloomberg_unique_id as id_underlying_instrument_source,
    ss.abor_security_number as id_instrument,
    ss.cppib_sec_id as id_instrument_alternate,
    ss.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
    ss.security_group_id as instrument_subgroup_code,	
    ss.security_group_name as instrument_subgroup_name,
    ss.abor_security_type_id AS instrument_type_code,
    ss.abor_security_type_name AS instrument_type_name,	
    ss.abor_security_name as instrument_name_source,
    ss.balance_nominal_number AS quantity,
    ss.clean_price as current_price,
    ss.clean_value_quotation_currency AS market_value,
    ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS cost_value,
    ss.quotation_currency_code AS quoted_currency_code,
    ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,
    ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS market_value_pc,
    ss.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_market_value,
    ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_market_value_pc,
    ss.clean_value_quotation_currency AS current_nominal,
    ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
    ss.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
    ss.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
    ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS cost_value_pc,

    -- Reference: Country
    mco.country_code,
    mco.country_name,

    -- Reference: Currency
    mcu.currency_code,
    mcu.currency_name,

    -- Party
    mp.cppib_party_id,
    mp.party_name ,
    mp.domicile_country_code,
	
    -- Security Classifications
    ms.cppib_sec_id,
    ms.cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
    ms.cppib_currency_code,
    ms.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code,

    -- Asset Options
    mo.document_type,
    mo.instrument_name,
    mo.instrument_description,
    mo.cppib_sec_id,
    mo.bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    mo.trade_name,
    mo.underlying_instrument_bloomberg_unique_id,
    mo.sedol,
    mo.ticker,
	
    -- Model Portfolio
    smp.unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
LEFT JOIN RankedSecurities sec 
    ON ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
left join RankedSecurities udl 
    on sec.abor_underlying_instrument_id = udl.scd_security_key_id
    and sec.business_date = udl.business_date

LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications ms
    ON ss.cppib_sec_id = cast(ms.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
    AND ms.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'

LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes mco
    ON ms.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = mco.country_code
    AND mco.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'

LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes mcu
    ON ms.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code = mcu.currency_code
    AND mcu.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'

LEFT JOIN asset.asset_options mo
    ON cast(mo.cppib_sec_id as varchar) = ss.cppib_sec_id
    AND mo.business_date = DATE '2025-06-02'

-- Preserved join to party.party
LEFT JOIN party.party mp
    ON mo.cppib_party_id = mp.cppib_party_id
